note: Catalogue capture for the held tier-5 English Wikipedia article 'Challenger 2'. The article is a secondary compilation, so every value is grade claimed and the registry marks primary_held false. It holds the FV4034 Challenger 2 main battle tank as a tracked entry. It publishes identity, the base mass, the gun-forward length, the width, the height, the ground clearance, the engine model and swept volume, the engine rating as a published range, the transmission gear count, the maximum road speed and the road range. The held tier-2 AESP 230-P-100-201 (1983) covers the Challenger 1 only, so it cannot support this entry; the name Challenger 2 is not applied to that manual. It publishes no tyre field, no track shoe width, no track pitch and no grouser statement, so the entry is not runtime-ready.

entries.maker: Vickers Defence Systems / BAE Systems Land & Armaments

operating_weight_kg.state: mass published as 64 t (63 long tons; 71 short tons); recorded as 64,000 kg with the tonne taken as 1,000 kg; the same row publishes 75 t with combat armour modules as a separate configuration, and the article states no kerb or gross weight

length_mm.state: overall length gun forward, published as 13.5 m (44 ft 3 in); the same row publishes 8.3 m (27 ft 3 in) without the gun as a separate configuration

width_mm.state: overall width, published as 3.5 m (11 ft 6 in); the same row publishes 4.2 m (13 ft 9 in) with applique armour as a separate configuration

height_mm.state: overall height, published as 2.49 m (8 ft 2 in); the published metre figure used directly

ground_clearance_mm.locator: Infobox, Specifications section, Ground clearance row
ground_clearance_mm.state: ground clearance, published as 0.5 m (1 ft 8 in); the published metre figure used directly

engine_model.state: engine published as a Perkins CV12-6A V12 diesel of 26.1 L

engine_displacement_l.state: engine swept volume, published as 26.1 L (1,590 cu in); the published litre figure used directly

published_power_hp.state: engine rating published as a range, 1,200 to 1,500 bhp (890 to 1,120 kW), with no net basis; recorded as the lower bound of the published range, not an average

gears.state: six forward and two reverse ratios, published as (6 fwd., 2 rev.); the article names the transmission type as epicyclic and does not state an automatic or manual class

max_speed_kmh.locator: Infobox, Specifications section, Maximum speed row
max_speed_kmh.state: maximum road speed, published as 37 mph (59 km/h) on-road; the same row publishes 25 mph (40 km/h) off-road as a separate state

range_km.locator: Infobox, Specifications section, Operational range row
range_km.state: operational range on-road on internal fuel, published as 550 km (340 mi); the same row publishes 250 km (160 mi) off-road as a separate state
